definitions.explanation: Using a product, service, or system on a trial basis, typically before committing to full adoption, purchase, or employment. Common in software free trials, product demo programs, and employment probation contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{試用|しよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{試用|しよう}⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a report on trying out the new product.

examples.japanese: {購入前|こうにゅうまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧30{日間|にちかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{試用|しよう}{期間|きかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}けて→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: We provide a 30-day trial period before purchase.

notes:
Compound of {試|し} ('try; test') and ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ ('use'). Note that the reading ⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧ is shared by several common homophones — ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧ ('use'), ⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧ ('specifications'), ⟦{私用|しよう}→私用：00459_shiyou⟧ ('personal use') — so context and kanji matter.

USAGE:
- Used as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {試用|しよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to try out').
- Frequent in product marketing (free trials), software contexts, and HR (probationary employment).
- Note: for HR use, ⟦{試用期間|しようきかん}→試用期間：15675_shiyoukikan⟧ ('probation period') is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試用|しよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to try out; to use on a trial basis
- {試用|しよう}{期間|きかん}: trial period; probation period
- {試用版|しようばん}: trial version (of software)
- ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧{試用|しよう}: free trial
- {試用|しよう}⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧: trial/review report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧: use; usage — everyday 'using'; not necessarily trial-based.
- ⟦{試|ため}し→試し：03410_tameshi⟧: trial; test — native Japanese reading; more casual, e.g., ⟦お{試|ため}し→お試し：09820_otameshi⟧ ('a trial; giving it a go').
- ⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: experience; trial experience — emphasizes first-hand experience, as in {体験版|たいけんばん} ('demo version').
- ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: test — a general katakana word, used for testing in many contexts.
